Explicit harm events are posted by actor code at VA 0x4C0087, 0x4C1794 and 0x4C8DFA. This is not an arbitrary proximity trigger.

events.fireLabelMismatch: At runtime Fire Ctrl12 penalizes new/spreading fire by 20 points and Ctrl13 pays 50 cash per extinguished flame; their UI labels suggest the opposite.
events.speederLabelMismatch: Speeder Ctrl2 labeled Incmtl Points is routed into cash for event 33, not score.
events.note: All 53 central switch cases enumerated. This list does not by itself prove what player action generated a case.

service.aircraftTweakRegistration: Nine 14-entry registrations starting at 0x490A60. Ctrl0..13 are loaded; any later rate lines in HELI.TWK cannot override the direct rate table used by these quote functions.
service.math: Repair=floor(damagePoints*repairPrice16_16/65536), fuel=floor(missingGallons*fuelPrice16_16/65536). Field multiplier 3 is applied AFTER truncation when AP246 tile is not within square radius 2.
service.fieldEligibility: The manual service input requires on-foot state 3, an owned craft, a nonzero repair or fuel quote, and being outside radius 1 of AP246. The service dialog then initializes repair and fuel sliders plus a gas slider for owners. Accepting calls the actual repair, fuel, and gas updates. HELP/99REF claims repairs are hangar-only; this code path implements field repair and lists all three sliders. No player input was sent to test field reachability.

aircraftSale.formula: max(floor(newPrice/2), newPrice-floor(heli[0x334]*0.5)) for an existing matching aircraft. 0 when not found.

promotion.customMode: Separate non-career branch at 0x45543A resets score and awards 2000 cash when score exceeds its computed goal; not the career city payout.

flightSalary.source: HELP/ENGLISH/18REF.HTM says pilots earn salary for flying time. No periodic player wage amount/cadence identified. The sole literal +1 direct cash call at 0x4A2C88 belongs to a conditional object event handler also emitting per-car events; it does not prove player hourly pay. No evidence for 5/60s.

doctorOfficerService.source: 18REF describes costs for doctors, police and emergency dispatch. No matching fixed debit found among all 30 direct cash calls nor literal pointers to the cash-adjustment function in this PE. Hypothetical other mutation paths are not excluded. 25 per hire and 10 per emergency call are unverified.

handlingCapacity.maxLoad: HELI Ctrl8 Max Load enters slot +8 of the 92-byte aircraft profile (0x490AA3). The HUD computes 11 * currentLoad[0x1D0] / maxLoad at 0x45C40D..41E. It is a load quantity, not a seat count. Exact unit not established.
handlingCapacity.aircraftReferenceResourceIds: RT_STRING 480..487 explicitly gives separate kg/lb empty weights, capacities and seat counts for the eight regular helicopters. These cannot be substituted for the simulation value.
handlingCapacity.apacheMass: No verified empty mass in catalog RT480..487; excluded.
handlingCapacity.bucketCapacity: See Heli Ropestuff TWK; do not infer litres/kg without a verified conversion.
